trigger: Creator rejected The Exit Code as low-shareability and wrong direction.
calibration_rule: A route must create a no-explanation partner tag, not only a recognizable private truth.

routes.title: Mummy Ko Mat Batana
routes.lane: two-person alibi / harmless desi mischief / couple conspiracy
slide_spine: Some love comes with an alibi.
routes.why_people_share: Viewers can tag the partner who backs their tiny harmless lies to family, shops, or the house.
physical_receipts: tag hidden under dupatta or cushion
routes.zuv_role: He is not a savior; he joins the harmless bit as co-conspirator.
routes.risk: Must stay harmless and playful. No serious lying, money secrecy, or making parents look foolish.

routes.title: Main Nahi Bol Rahi
routes.lane: angry care / fight language / care leaks through silence
routes.why_people_share: A lot of couples recognize the person who is angry but still caring.
physical_receipts: Zuv responding gently without a speech
routes.zuv_role: He reads care underneath anger and answers with one small action.
routes.risk: Could drift into Softness Under Fire/apology lane or become too tender instead of funny.

routes.title: Nothing To Wear
routes.lane: wardrobe chaos / outfit decision / visual physical proof
slide_spine: He married "kuch pehenne ko nahi hai."
routes.why_people_share: Very broad partner-tag behavior around getting ready and outfit indecision.
physical_receipts: Zuv seated patiently but actively choosing one
routes.zuv_role: He participates in the decision without mocking her.
routes.risk: Could become generic wife joke or too close to old overpacking/outfit chaos if not made specific.

routes.title: Jo Karna Hai Karo
routes.lane: permission that is not permission / desi relationship warning label
routes.why_people_share: The phrase is instantly taggable, especially in desi couples.
physical_receipts: both laughing after the tension breaks
routes.zuv_role: He recognizes the real emotional ask and chooses the relationship over literal permission.
routes.risk: Highest stereotype risk. Must be affectionate and mutual, not 'wife trap' content.
